recognize_zh: 高倍下在淡嗜酸性壞死背景中有大量核碎屑（karyorrhectic debris），周圍是細胞質淡染、核呈新月形/C 形的組織球與吞噬碎屑的巨噬細胞，且幾乎看不到嗜中性球；這種「大量凋亡碎屑＋組織球、無嗜中性球」的組合是菊池病（Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease）的特徵。
features: Abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris scattered in a fibrinoid eosinophilic background
Histiocytes with crescentic (C-shaped) eccentric nuclei and pale foamy cytoplasm
Tingible-body macrophages containing phagocytosed apoptotic debris
Admixed larger activated lymphoid cells (immunoblasts/plasmacytoid dendritic cells)
describe_en: High-power view of the lymph node shows a necrotizing area with abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris set in an eosinophilic fibrinoid background. The debris is surrounded by numerous histiocytes, many with crescentic eccentric nuclei, tingible-body macrophages, and scattered larger activated lymphoid cells. Neutrophils and eosinophils are notably absent, and no granulomas are seen. The findings are consistent with histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis (Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease), pending exclusion of lupus lymphadenitis and infection.

ddx.vs: Lupus lymphadenitis looks nearly identical but may show hematoxylin bodies, plasma cells and Azzopardi phenomenon, with serologic confirmation.
Bacterial, cat-scratch or herpes lymphadenitis contains neutrophils, microabscesses or granulomas, which are absent in Kikuchi disease.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell or diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with necrosis
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows sheets of cytologically atypical cells with clonal immunophenotype, whereas Kikuchi histiocytes are MPO+/CD68+ and CD8+ T cells are reactive.
